description:
Use this when the user wants a recap of how their posts did and what to post next: "how did last week go",
        "give me my analytics", "what should I post next". For the last `days` days (default 7): posts and views by
        platform, the top posts by views at 24 hours, the views of the period before for comparison, the best time to
        post, and post_next: top clips never posted or drafted, each with the platform it earned most on. timezone: IANA
        name, e.g. America/Chicago. Covers posts RipClip published or planned.
        Not for: one post's numbers (get_post_stats), platform against platform (compare_platforms), a chart in the chat
        (show_report) or the reasons behind the results (why_it_worked). Free and read only. Next: plan_posts drafts the
        post_next clips.
name: weekly_report
title: Weekly report
